validation.skip_reason: Flask is not installed in the packaging environment

known_limits: The real Qwen smoke test must run in the deployment environment.
Flask is required only for the optional web interface.
Full-file replacement requires a fresh complete read; files larger than the configured read limit must use range updates.
A write without an applicable executed test suite is reported as partial verification, even when compileall and exact reread pass.
Cross-language verification depends on available project tests and language-specific checks.
Multi-file rollback provides all-or-restored behavior but filesystems cannot atomically replace several files in one operation.
The response-quality gate validates the structured claim ledger; it does not perform full natural-language theorem proving over every sentence.
Phase control prevents common loops, but complex edits may still need a blocking user question when required files cannot be identified within two investigation turns.
Sentence numbering ignores Markdown headings but still requires the model to reference the visible sentence order correctly; out-of-range references receive one correction attempt.
Observable history is available only for persisted jobs that still exist in the runtime queue database.
The history is operational observability, not a reasoning transcript; raw prompts, raw model responses, source contents and chain-of-thought are intentionally excluded.
Git tools require the git executable and an active Git work tree; otherwise they return an explicit unavailable/not-repository result.
run_tests can focus a path only for pytest; other detected test runners still execute their configured full suite.
git_diff intentionally truncates diff text before it reaches the model; use a narrower path when the relevant hunk is outside the bound.
execution_trace observes recorded runtime facts and does not diagnose them; the LLM must inspect code/tests separately to establish causes.
